newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dlr closes firmer reflecting fixed income.
newsitem.headline: Canada dlr closes firmer reflecting fixed income.

text.p: * Canada's dollar firmed to C$1.3700 (US$0.7294) from Friday's close of C$1.3732 (US$0.7283) in active trading, dealers said.
* They said buying was spread out among market players and reflected a strong Canada bond market.
* The currency will likely hold its range overnight and into Tuesday, looking forward to new economic data on Wednesday.
The spread between 30-year benchmark bonds narrowed to 81 basis points on Monday from 83 basis points at Friday's close.
The currency will likely hold steady overnight and on Tuesday with an eye out for new economic data on Wednesday, dealers said.
The U.S. Federal Reserve is expected to release its beige book report on the state of regional economies on Wednesday.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.0934 marks from Friday's close of 1.0861 marks and to 79.67 yen from Friday's close of 79.42 yen.
